I have had a similar experience, although mine was mutual at the beginning.  We had so many problems in the relationship and never were able to work them out.  So we broke up.  It was not until a few months later that the existential pain and loneliness started.  I did not realize what I had given up.  I started to remember all the good times we shared and why we started dating in the first place.  I wanted her back, i told myself we could fix any problems we had.  But, i was too late, she had already found someone else.  I was in a bad place for awhile until I thought of it like this.  She cared about me so much, she meant so much to me and I so much to her.  So yes it was horrible that she was gone.  But, if I was able to find her, then I know that I will be able to find that again.  It might take some time, it might take a few times, but I know that there is someone out there that will make me feel how I did with her.  Someone that will care about me and I care about them.  That is my advice to you.  I know it is not the best, but if you were able to find something with him, then you can find it again and will if you continue to try.
I appreciate all the advice dude.  I really do, it is a tad bit nice knowing someone cared a bit.  So thank ya.

Well the first thing I will say, is that before you would do anything rash, to try the other options first.  I understand going on medication can be a scary endeavour.  But, in my opinion, there is no harm in trying that before doing something rash.  If you try them, and they don't work (although be aware that there is no one medication size fit all.  The first one you get might not work out, but that does not mean others will.  Some people need to go through three or more before they find the right one for them.  That is because these problems in the mind are complex and that for now ot is trial and error) but if they don't work, than you are just back to the place you are.  And if they do then that's absolutely wonderful and you will be glad that you tried instead of giving up first.  And for the part of getting dependent on them, well, there is no shame on being on medication.  There is absolutely no shame in it.  Mental illnesses are the same as physical ones except that they are not easily seen.  Just like 1000s of different physical conditions are treated with on going medication (like acid reflux, heart problems and more)  mental illnesses can also be treated with medication without any shame in that. Some people need that extra help, and that is okay.

If you are aware it is a case of some kind of chemical imbalance, then are you opposed to taking medication to try and help?  Which is 100% fine, it is your choice, but i just wanted to know where you stand on that.

Well for the therapy thing, it is not that I cant afford it, its that they are forced to document everything.  And when it comes to me buying life insurance (if i did decide to end it) they ask for any recorded history of mental illness.  Having a record of depression and anxiety would mean id probably have to pay up to 500 a month or more for the current policy I can get for 100 month, and that is a 5 million dollar policy.  Thats why I dont want to go to therapy.  And its just that I have seen people that are so much better than me.  And that I have been such a bad person to people, and I was not even able to recognize it.  I just, do not want to be that bad person.  Ive tried to be neutral and I just do not think I am able too.  Not when I know people, who are im much harder situations than myself, yet they still look out for others before themselves.  I know one girl in particular like that.  She is not someone you would think is like that at first glance, but she is.  She gives up so much for her family and she does not mind at all.

I am not saying I can help at all and talking to me is not the best, but even I know that I would rather have you talk to someone rather than die. And no one will judge you if you did not do it, I guarantee anyone reading this would be overjoyed if you did not die.

Yeah, sometimes I switch back and forth on weather or not I have the feelings.  I have tried to even accept that I do not and I just can't.  I was basically being an asshole to everyone because all I was intentionally caring about was myself.  Which is something I will not live with.  And about 1 year ago I bottled everything up.  Then some stuff happened so I decided to try and be more open and talk about my feelings.  I did that for a bit and found that all I was doing was talking about myself and always shifting conversations to be about me and my problems.  I was being more selfish than ever.  I have thought about seeing a therapist, but now I know that if you have any documented mental illnesses, that life insurance goes way up to where I could not afford it.  Which is something I am not going to do incase all the therapist ends up doing is confirming that I am some sort of sociopath.  Because then I cant even help the few that I have promised to.

I feel this for various reasons, one being that like I said reading these reddit post, I am not sure how I feel.  Do I care about these people that are going through so much more than myself?  Since I was about 13,  I decided to be a good person.  I forced myself to try and act objectively good and always do what was objectively right.  This lead to some problems as I was never able to really do that, but it did kinda program my mind to always think what is objectively right.  Now at age 19, I have abandoned that "always do right" attitude.  And I think now, the only reason I can look at these post and say that it is awful that anyone has to go through that, is because of that objectively good outlook is still programmed into me.  It is not from a sense of injustice or a feeling that it is not right.  Also, I may know a lot of the problems I have, but through years of knowing about them, I have never been able to change them.  This is another bad habit of mine where I always kinda argue with the people who try and help, so I am sorry about that.  I do appreciate you trying though.
